message: Vector Rebel 3.2.73: Daily Captain PPE tour check required if assigned to ANY unit on either day, never waived for a different unit/shift. Off or deployed for both days means not required; missing staffing evidence is unknown.
releaseNotes: Corrections to the November 16 Captain PPE attendance review: verified work assignments to ANY unit on either day of the two-day C-shift tour trigger required PPE checks, including swing staff working on a different apparatus or shift. Prior alternative-unit or different-shift exemption suggestions were wrong and are retired. Two positive full 24-hour leave/deployment records for both days can establish not required; manual full-tour OFF remains supported. If Scout lacks good direct matched source observations for both days, the report shows amber ? (attendance unverified) rather than falsely marking PPE missed or off. Real completed native PPE inspections always remain green. Positive unit evidence wins over a stale manual OFF or different-shift exception and is labeled as conflicting when applicable. The report is recalculated locally from read-only Rebel Command Scout evidence while preserving the original actual Item Log audit snapshot, native receipt dates and timestamps. Unit assignments and absence distinctions are visible by person/tour and a refresh control is provided. No CrewSense or Vector inspections are written, created or submitted. Existing other SCBA protections remain compatible.
